subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Hi Samantha / Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap:
- Primary use case is inference for clinical notes extraction and embeddings for search.
- Key success metrics: sub-200ms 95th-percentile latency for short requests, cost target ~$0.0008/token, and strong data isolation controls for PHI.
- Next step: technical deep dive (60–90 min) with your ML and infra teams to walk architecture, throughput targets, VPC/KMS requirements, and a hands-on runbook for a pilot.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 4/20 10:00–11:30
- Wed 4/21 13:00–14:30
- Thu 4/22 09:00–10:30

I’ve attached a short proposed agenda (proposed_agenda.pdf). If one of these works, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in our solutions engineer (Dylan) and platform engineer (Camila) — they’ll drive the technical Q&A.

Agenda highlights (60–90 min):
- 10 min: quick goals + current infra overview
- 25–35 min: ML architecture & model selection (config/quantization options)
- 25–30 min: infra/networking (VPC, KMS, audit logs), throughput sizing
- 10 min: pilot plan, milestones, and action items

Thanks — looking forward to diving in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: proposed_agenda.pdf (1 page)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. We’re very interested in a deep dive.

We’ll definitely bring our ML lead (Alex Johnson) and our infra lead (Priya Menon, priya.menon@acmehealth.com) — they want to cover the following items specifically:
- VPC peering / PrivateLink options and inbound/outbound network flow requirements
- KMS integrations and key rotation policies
- Expected concurrency/throughput for batch vs real-time paths
- Data retention and audit log detail for SOC2 compliance

From your proposed slots, Wed 4/21 13:00–14:30 PST works best for us. If possible, can you confirm the meeting length at 90 minutes so we don’t rush the infra discussion?

Also can you add any pre-reads? They’d like to review quantization/precision tradeoffs and our recommended pilot runbook ahead of time.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director, Data Platform | Acme Health Tech
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com
